name: Karfell
description: The coldest, most remote realm, where Valki is held.

timeline.summary: Tibalt chains Valki and imprisons him in King Narfi's glacial palace in Karfell, striking a deal with Narfi.
timeline.quote: So long as Valki stayed deep in the dungeon of this King Narfi's glacial palace

pages_say.description: A frozen realm of wraiths and undead that once collided with Bretagard.
The coldest, most remote realm, where Valki is held.
The frozen realm of the dead from which the draugr come.
